Newrays Two LLC Mining is a fenced industrial site in Henry County, Tennessee, mapped here because it hosts computing hardware, but its name and layout point to a cryptocurrency mining operation rather than a conventional colocation or cloud facility. Sites like this pair racks of application-specific mining hardware with an electricity feed chosen mainly for low cost, and they are typically built and run by small, privately held operating companies rather than the wholesale developers behind most large data centers. Tennessee has drawn a number of such operations in recent years, often locating near utilities or gas infrastructure willing to sell large, flexible blocks of power to a single industrial customer.

No public filing, news coverage, or operator website naming Newrays Two LLC's ownership, power source, or hardware count could be found. A Tennessee Secretary of State business filing under this name would be the most direct way to confirm who runs the site and when it was formed, and any local news coverage of mining activity around Paris, Tennessee would help establish its scale and history. Until that documentation surfaces, this listing reflects the site's self-described purpose rather than a verified operational profile, and no capacity, size, or ownership figures are published here.

Newrays Two LLC Mining is a fenced industrial site in Henry County, Tennessee, tagged in OpenStreetMap as a data center but named and described as a mining operation. Its self-descriptive label suggests a cryptocurrency mining facility rather than a conventional colocation or cloud campus, a class of site that typically pairs application-specific hardware with low-cost electricity from flexible industrial power agreements. No operator website, corporate filing, or news coverage naming the facility, its power source, capacity, or ownership could be located despite direct search.

Tennessee has 24 mapped computing facilities on this site's registry, of which only four publish power capacity figures totaling 12.13 MW. Newrays Two LLC Mining publishes no specifications, so its power demand, rack count, or hardware inventory remain unknown. The facility cannot be ranked against peers in the state by any published metric.

This site is unverifiable as currently documented. Confirmation of who operates the facility, when it was built, what power it draws, and how much hardware it hosts would require a Tennessee Secretary of State business filing under the Newrays Two LLC name or local news coverage of mining activity near Paris, Tennessee. Until that documentation surfaces, the listing reflects only the self-assigned name and the industrial location.
